nodes.label: Tenant blog authoring, publishing and lifecycle management
Unique blog slug generation with numeric collision suffixes
Reading-time estimate derived from stripped HTML at 200 wpm
Publishing snapshots the post into an immutable version row first
Publish gate: a post must have title and content before going live
Postgres 23505 on slug is translated into an operator-readable message
Blog version rollback restores content and SEO metadata as a draft
Version retention: delete all but the newest N snapshots
Rollback deliberately lands in draft — an explicit publish is required to go live
Bonzah low-balance alert threshold configuration
Alert config edits are mirrored into a BONZAH_LOW_BALANCE reminder row
Config upsert is hand-rolled as select-then-insert-or-update, not a DB upsert
Bonzah spendable-balance monitoring with 60s auto-refresh
Rationale: never restore the allocated>0?allocated:broker fallback — $0 allocation showed a false live balance
needsAllocation: broker funds exist but nothing is allocated, so policies will fail
Test mode uses platform-shared Bonzah credentials; live mode needs tenant credentials
Bonzah operator portal host differs per mode (insillion vs sb.insillion sandbox)
While live, the test balance is fetched in parallel for side-by-side display
Bonzah insurance partner onboarding submission and review status
Rationale: onboarding draft is stored in the DB so a paused application survives browser and device changes
Active submission = latest pending or approved; a rejection unblocks re-submission
Submit fires AI verdict and partner email best-effort so neither can block the application
Training quiz score and completion timestamp are stamped onto the submission row
Live Bonzah premium quoting for CDW / RCLI / SLI / PAI coverage
300ms debounce on coverage toggles to avoid a quote request per checkbox click
No coverage selected short-circuits to a zero premium without calling the insurer
COVERAGE_INFO: insurer-verbatim coverage limits, deductibles and exclusions
Rationale: COVERAGE_INFO is compliance data transcribed from Bonzah's Embedded Insurance Compliance Requirements — do not reword
Rationale: card says Collision Damage Waiver, not the source doc's Warranty, because that is the wording the renter agrees to
Rationale: COVERAGE_INFO is duplicated byte-for-byte across apps and must be edited in lockstep
Rationale: PAI deductible corrected from None to $25 — the green No Deductible badge understated a real deductible
SLI is excess-only and cannot be sold without RCLI (requiresRcli flag)
All liability/damage coverages exclude cars-for-hire and delivery work (Uber/Lyft/DoorDash)
Bonzah training quiz served without answers and graded server-side
Rationale: the correct-answer index never reaches the client — a public view omits it and the edge function is authoritative
Bulk retry of insurance policies stuck on insufficient allocated balance
Rationale: policies are retried sequentially to avoid overwhelming the insurer API
Retry passes a synthetic portal-retry-<rentalId> payment-intent id instead of a real Stripe id
Per-policy failures are counted rather than aborting, and reported as full/partial/none
Bonzah onboarding training videos — global content, not tenant-scoped
Per-vehicle make/model insurance eligibility check before offering cover
Rationale: fail-open — a technical failure must never block selling insurance
Eligibility is treated as static data and cached for 10 minutes
Operator approval / rejection of pending customer bookings
Approval captures the Stripe pre-authorisation; rejection releases the hold uncharged
Rental rows are created by the capture edge function, not the portal — the hook only audit-logs the returned rentalId
Manual availability blocking of a vehicle from the fleet calendar
Blocks represent off-platform usage such as the car being rented out on Turo
Fleet calendar timeline merging rentals, manual blocks and block-only vehicles
Range-overlap predicate treating a NULL end_date as an open-ended rental
A full vehicle list is fetched so vehicles with only blocks still get a timeline row
Search / status / payment-mode filters are applied client-side against computed status
Displayed rental status is derived from dates plus auto-extend state, not the stored status alone
Today's pickups, returns, active count and weekly booking density
Week density is computed in JS over a single overlap query instead of seven count queries
Rental cancellation with full, partial or no refund
Rationale: a failed cancellation notification must not fail the cancellation itself
The refund edge function returns a notificationData payload the client relays to the notifier
A cancelled (uncaptured) payment is reported as a released hold rather than a refund
Omnichannel operator inbox across in-app, SMS, WhatsApp, email and voice
Inbound SMS from unknown numbers parked as unlinked threads awaiting customer linkage
Unread count and last-message preview are fetched with two queries per channel (N+1 fan-out)
Realtime message and read events invalidate the channel list and unknown-thread list
Cursor-paginated message thread loaded newest-first and reversed for display
Incoming realtime messages are patched straight into the React Query cache instead of refetching
Realtime inserts are de-duplicated by scanning every cached page for the message id
Read receipts mark the opposite party's messages read in both directions
Realtime room join/leave is guarded by a ref so remounts do not double-join
Trax AI staff assistant conversation with sources, charts and rental requests
Human-in-the-loop confirm/reject before the assistant executes a proposed action
The assistant is called by raw fetch with an explicit bearer session token, bypassing functions.invoke
tenantId is mandatory on every assistant call — without it the assistant refuses to answer
Conversation state is component-local; only the conversationId ties turns together server-side
Modives CMD driver-licence and insurance verification for a customer
Verification magic link delivered over email / SMS / WhatsApp with a resend path
5s polling while licence status is Pending so webhook updates surface without a reload
Rationale: Modives compliance forbids server-side caching of results, so staleTime stays 0
Rationale: supabase-js swallows the edge function's error body behind a generic FunctionsHttpError, so it is unwrapped manually
Terminal licence states are Valid, Invalid or Expired — everything else keeps polling
CMD rows share identity_verifications with other providers and are selected by provider='cmd'
CMS media library: upload, delete and alt-text editing
Client-side upload guard: 5MB cap and JPEG/PNG/WebP/SVG only
Media rows with tenant_id NULL are platform-shared assets every tenant can see
Delete must remove both the storage object and the DB row, with the path parsed back out of the public URL
Uploads are attributed to the app_users row resolved from the current auth user
Portal convention: every React Query key is namespaced by tenant?.id and gated on enabled: !!tenant
Tenant isolation is re-asserted client-side with .eq('tenant_id') on every read and write alongside RLS
Portal convention: mutations emit a structured audit-log action after success
Newer tables are reached through (supabase as any) / 'table' as never casts because generated types lag the schema
